Why watch baseball next to the stadium?――THE LIVEの評判と都市経営

THE LIVE next to Yokohama Stadium looks paradoxical: why pay to watch a screen beside the real match? From 2026 visitor reviews, variable seat prices, pickup and sound complaints, the old city hall redevelopment, and DeNA's stadium strategy, the answer emerges: this is a business selling reasons to gather, not merely pixels. The article keeps facts, visitor impressions, economic hypotheses, and proposals separate.
